items.prompt: What does the minimum of five timeit repeats describe?

options.why: The minimum is not a tail percentile.

options.text: A universal runtime on every CPU
options.why: The measurement is local to its setup.

options.text: The best observed repeat under that local setup
options.why: Noise, setup and workload limits still apply.

options.text: The number of correctness proofs completed
options.why: Timing repetitions do not prove program correctness.

items.explanation: Report what the timing actually measures, including repeat/number setup and runtime/hardware context.
